title: Esklett's provisional long-term immigration by employment sector, 2025-26, against the Population Policy's allowances
setting: A fictional self-governing island in the Irish Sea, Esklett, with a Population Register kept in two systems either side of a 2023 move and a Population Policy that sets each employment sector an allowance of long-term immigration: the island, its parishes, its bodies and its people are fictional, and every record is synthetic.
